# In-app Notifications Implementation Plan

**Goal:** Deliver private trip notifications without duplicate events or changes to billing.
**Architecture:** D1 notification rows generated by SQL triggers in the mutation transaction; authenticated cursor-paginated API; shared-shell dialog inbox.
**Tech Stack:** existing React, TypeScript, D1/SQLite, Drizzle migrations and Dialog primitive. No dependencies or email provider.
**Spec:** docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-25-notifications-design.md
**Execution:** implement in this existing Site checkout; preserve the approved UI and source/hosting workflow.

## Constraints and review focus
- No introduction, contact or meeting-note contents in alerts.
- Failed/no-op/repeated mutations must not generate duplicate alerts.
- Read state must be recipient-scoped and pagination stable for identical timestamps.
- Failed inbox requests must preserve loaded items and offer retry.
- Late responses after closing the inbox must not replace newer state.
- Existing trips are not backfilled; no email/push or billing activation.

## Tasks
- [x] 1. Write migration integration tests asserting notification schema exists, recipient/event correctness, no-op suppression and trigger rollback. Run to observe failure. Add notifications schema and generated migration with transition triggers. Re-run tests.
- [x] 2. Add failing route tests for guest denial, recipient isolation, cursor validation/pagination and idempotent read marking. Implement GET /api/notifications and POST /api/notifications using existing identity/body/origin helpers. Use 20 items plus a lookahead row; order by created_at,id descending. Return generic event labels, trip ID, read timestamp and unread count, never SELECT *.
- [x] 3. Add failing UI checks for opening, empty/error states and read behavior. Add Notifications control to AppShell for signed-in users. Reuse Dialog; load on open, poll while visible every 30 seconds; show the last known unread badge, clear error/retry states, Load more and per-item Mark read. Links open current authorized trip detail. No blocking page-load requests.
- [ ] 4. Run focused tests, typecheck, full npm test and storage tests. Review desktop/mobile inbox. Update feature documentation and test evidence. Publish through Sites, verify terminal deployment status, then push approved code to GitHub.

## Expected interfaces
GET /api/notifications?cursor=<encoded JSON {createdAt,id}> returns {items:[{id,tripId,type,createdAt,readAt}],unreadCount,nextCursor}. POST accepts {id} and returns {ok:true}; marks only matching recipient rows, otherwise 404.
Schema: notifications(id TEXT PK, recipient TEXT, trip_id TEXT, type TEXT, created_at TEXT, read_at TEXT NULL). Index (recipient,created_at,id) and (recipient,read_at). Triggers use randomblob IDs and UTC timestamps; no historical backfill.

Review evidence: independent reviewer found background refresh could preserve a stale cursor and skip items. Added failing lifecycle tests and changed refresh to replace items and cursor together. Focused tests pass; full npm test passed (130 pass, 1 optional paid-AI skip), typecheck passed, three storage checks passed, and local D1 migration plus desktop/mobile inbox/read-state checks passed. Deployment remains.
